notes.title: 2018.11.19 - Update
notes.content:
- The range of danger aware is increased by 50%

Comment : The patch was done to prevent sudden death due to a late recognition of danger.



- The phone's max charge is now limited to 100%

Comment : We saved the main character from dying by phone explosion.



- The bug about mouse cursor clicking outside of the game when on windowed mode is now fixed.

Comment : We accepted the opinion from the review of the game.



- The access to some parts of the map is now prohibited.

Comment : Now you'll have a lesser chance to die in an unreturnable places.
